sources.visible_excerpt: Dogleg Project Venture Info Dogleg is an industrial design studio based in Oslo. We approach industrial design with an open mind, much like navigating a dogleg turn, where the path is uncertain. Project 1: Eligent The wall socket is one of the most manufactured objects in the built environment, and one of the least considered. Project 2: REV Ocean Beachlander How do you build a craft for protecting the ocean through exploration, without adding to the very problem it's meant to help solve? Project 3: Twine Task Chair A chair that anyone can understand is a chair anyone can repair. See all our projects Venture Through Dogleg Venture, we invest resources in developing ideas we believe in, both in our own projects and in client projects. Dyktige lærere Pedagogisk utdanning, profesjonelle utøvere med bred erfaring. 🧑‍🏫 🏠 Tre steder Kastellet skole, Munkerud skole og Lambertseter fritidsklubb ⭐️ Siden 2004 Over 20 år som en viktig kulturinstitusjon i bydel Nordstrand. 🎪 Konserter & forestillinger Elevkonserter og teaterforestillinger hvert semester. Elevkonserter og forestillinger ​ ​ Hvert semester arrangerer vi konserter og forestillinger der elevene får vise hva de har lært. " Mestringsfølelse over å ha lært et nytt grep på gitaren, sunget en tone man ikke trodde man klarte, eller stått foran mange mennesker på en scene – det er noe helt spesielt. Våre elever utvikler seg både musikalsk og personlig – flere har gått videre til høyere musikkutdanning. Klar for å starte? ​ ​ Påmelding er uforpliktende. Vi kontakter deg for å avtale time og finne det perfekte kurset. sources.title: Transformations that matter
sources.visible_excerpt: What we do How we work News Fractal Change About Transformations that matter Create the shifts you want to see - for an equitable and thriving world We need a radically different approach to respond to the challenges of our time. But how do we transform at the scale, speed and depth that is called for? After decades in the field of sustainability, we recognize that how we implement solutions is as important as the solutions themselves. And it all starts with you. When you and your team work strategically to shift unsustainable patterns across systems and cultures, and show up with courage and creativity to create a world where people and nature thrive, the results can be extraordinary. We have seen it happen. Our values- and research-based approach brings together the practical, political, and personal spheres of transformation. This represents a fractal approach to scaling transformations for sustainability. How we work Let’s work together to foster transformations that enable people, communities, organizations, and nature to thrive together at every scale. What we do Join our flagship program in 2027 to grow your transformational leadership, shift systems and cultures, and create lasting change. Learn more and sign up We'd love to talk to you! Get in touch team@cchange.no Øvre Slottsgate 3 0157 Oslo News and events LinkedIn Instagram
